houdini.line: And when presented like a genie who does magic like Houdini
stanza: At a cocktail party when listening to a good God-themed joke, or
Or when the crazies say He hates us
And they get so red in the head you think they're 'bout to choke
When told He'll give you money if you just pray the right way
And when presented like a genie who does magic like Houdini
Or grants wishes like Jiminy Cricket and Santa Claus
Through the glass, I'd watch you breathe
And paler than you've ever been
With your life the only thing in my mind —
We pull you from the water
